title: Baby Leo & Friends Learn About Friendship Fun!
summary: Today, Baby Leo and his friends dive into the magic of friendship! With Bella's clever ideas, they explore how being a good friend makes playtime special. Together, they learn that friendship means caring and having fun together!
lesson: Kids learn the importance of friendship and caring for one another.

beats.beat: Baby Leo and Marjona are playing with building blocks. They remember how fun it was to help each other in previous adventures.
beats.character_action: They decide to build a big tower together, laughing and sharing ideas.

beats.beat: Bella hops in with a smile. She has an idea to play a friendship game!
beats.character_action: She gathers everyone and explains the game called ‘Friends’ Compliments.’

beats.beat: All friends take turns saying nice things about each other. Bobo gives the best hugs, and Marjona sings the funniest songs!
beats.character_action: Friends giggle and cheer, feeling happy from kind words.

beats.beat: Suddenly, the blocks start to wobble! Oh no! They need to be careful.
beats.character_action: Baby Leo reminds everyone to work together and support each other.

beats.beat: Each friend uses their special skill. Bella hops to grab blocks, Twinkle glows to light the way, and Bobo lifts heavy parts!
beats.character_action: They all support Baby Leo as he places the last block on the tower.

beats.beat: The tower is complete! They cheer together, feeling proud of what they built as friends.
beats.character_action: They share high fives and happy hugs.

beats.beat: They realize that friendship is not just about fun but also about helping each other. Bella suggests they should celebrate!
beats.character_action: They decide to have a snack party with fruits and veggies.

beats.beat: While enjoying their delicious snack, they talk about how great it is to be friends and care for one another.
beats.character_action: Marjona sings a happy song about friendship, and they all join in.

beats.beat: The day ends with the friends looking at their tower, remembering how they helped each other.
beats.character_action: They promise to always care for their friendship and help one another.

beats.beat: They share one last hug and wave goodbye, excited for their next adventure!
beats.character_action: They laugh and hop off together into the sunset.
